_note: Everything the owner may want to change without touching code. Models are tried in this order; a provider without a key in the environment is skipped.
_local: A file config.local.json next to this one (never committed) may override any setting on one machine: local_browser_python = the Python that has a working headless browser, local_site_config = the site config the keys are read from.
_note_ai: The videos use gemini-2.5-flash on purpose: Google counts free quota per model, and the site's editor uses the 3.5 models. Put a stronger model first only if its quota is not the editor's.
_youtube: false = no YouTube searches (set it in config.local.json on a machine where YouTube has become slow or refuses; GitHub never asks it)
